title: Nadia Faisal ESS509 Sample Resource
subtitle: Seabrook — Choose actions to reduce plastic litter

scope.teacher_screen: Publicly accessible Answers for the teacher screen, authorised for this university sample.
scope.exit_slip: Created separately by the user; do not build an exit-slip form or recorder. The third website screen is teacher answers, not R3.

welcome: Seabrook is a fictional coastal community. Explore its shopping mall, beach and suburbs. Then decide where three different actions could help reduce plastic litter.
explore_intro: Choose a location on the map, or use the location buttons. Read or listen to what happens there. Look for clues that will help you compare actions.
explore_instruction: Open a labelled feature to read about it, or choose Read all location information.
planning_intro: Choose one action for each location. Each action can be used once. Leave one action unused. Try two different arrangements and compare your reasons.
allocation_rule_explanation: For this trial, Seabrook has one package for each action. Each package can go to one location. The community will use three packages.
simulation_explanation: Imagine that each location would have 100 pieces of loose plastic litter during four weeks without a new action. The action numbers show how many pieces are prevented, collected or caught during those four weeks. They are made up for this activity.
effects_heading: Simulated litter reduction over four weeks
counting_note: Count each piece once, at the place where it came from. Rubbish moving to another place is not counted again.
judgment_note: Compare the numbers and the location clues. A recommendation needs a reason and a possible limitation.
handoff_to_individual_task: Keep your comparison ready. Your teacher will provide a separate task for your own recommendation.

feedback.already_assigned: This action is at {location}. Choose Move action if you want to use it somewhere else.
feedback.occupied: {location} already has {action}. Choose Replace or Swap before changing it.
feedback.incomplete: Choose one action for each location before saving a complete plan.
feedback.reset_question: Clear this working arrangement? Your saved plans will stay.
feedback.audio_unavailable: Read-aloud is not available in this browser. You can still read the text or ask someone to read with you.
feedback.storage_note: Saved plans are on this device and browser. They are not submitted to your teacher.

vocabulary.definition: Information that supports a reason, such as a location detail or a number.
A smaller amount. Here, it means fewer pieces of loose plastic litter.
Something an action may miss, or something it depends on.
A drain that carries away rainwater from streets or other hard surfaces.
The raised edge beside a road.
A period for trying something. Seabrook’s trial lasts four weeks.
